answer: Each submission hangs on the ridge of a task receipt, and the velvet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Reaching the voyage of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
